scripts.fase3:web:preview: npm run fase3:web:build && wrangler pages dev fase3/web/dist --port 8788 --compatibility-date 2026-06-16
scripts.fase3:web:create: wrangler pages project create assistente-protocolos-fase3 --production-branch main
scripts.fase3:web:deploy: npm run fase3:web:build && wrangler pages deploy fase3/web/dist --project-name assistente-protocolos-fase3 --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.check:worker: cd cloudflare/api && uv run pywrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir ../../dist/worker
